Not to consume a batch of prepackaged rice with excessive cadmium found

Issue Date12.2.2026
Source of InformationCentre for Food Safety
Food ProductPrepackaged rice
Product Name and Description

Produce name: Rice

Brand: Acquerello

Place of origin: Italy

Net weight: 500 grams

Best-before date: February 17, 2032

Reason For Issuing Alert
  • The test result showed that the sample contained cadmium exceeding the legal limit.
  • Long-term excessive intake of cadmium may affect kidney functions.
